summary: End-to-end validation of Farm Feed Withdrawal Timer. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (settings defaults, PUT recomputes offsets, manual schedule anchor times incl. overnight rollover, CSV upload valid + bad-column 400, latest schedule alarm sort, pairing get/claim/regenerate incl. wrong-code 400, alarms active/ack/escalate/log, ack 404). Frontend desktop @1280: /dashboard renders; manual add of sheds 1/7:00, 2/7:30, 3/5:00 -> Generate produces shed-row-1 with auger 01:00 & lines 05:00, shed-row-3 with auger 23:00 (overnight); global AlarmOverlay fires with alarm-shed/alarm-action/alarm-done-button; DONE acks and next alarm surfaces; pairing-qr + 6-digit pairing-code visible; regen-code-button generates a new code; offset stepper Save (d-save) shows Saved. Frontend mobile @390: /settings pairing-card + pairing-code-input pairs successfully (paired-chip on /home shows Paired); save-settings-button works; /home shows scheduled events with times and status pills; /log shows 21 acknowledged entries newest first. No red screens, no console errors during flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_settings_doc always merges DEFAULT_SETTINGS on top of DB doc — safe but be aware that fields removed from DB will be re-added on next read.
delete_schedule endpoint does not deactivate active alarms; acceptable since alarms/active only queries the currently active schedule.
AlarmOverlay is intentionally global and covers all screens whenever a pending alarm's fire_at_utc <= now; tests must ack all alarms before asserting on non-alarm UI. Confirmed working as designed.
seed_data_creation: Tests created ephemeral manual schedules and pairing entries via the public API; no manual DB seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 backend pytest cases green. All 13 requested frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. Note: AlarmOverlay is global — before asserting on dashboard/home/log UI, ack all pending alarms (loop click alarm-done-button). Fresh pairing code can always be obtained via POST /api/pairing/regenerate.
